name: Spermatosis
source:
Liza (or Kevin, if you sway that way ;)) discovers that she has a rather unusual condition. The treatment is simple:
she needs to swallow sperm to get better. Unfortunately, there’s one minor, completely insignificant detail…
She’s a lesbian.
Kevin isn’t exactly in a better position either — he’s straight.
